products.name: Rope Tug Toy
products.short: Thick cotton rope for tug-of-war and gentle chewing.
desc: Tightly braided cotton that holds up to daily tug sessions. Supervise play and replace when it starts to fray.

products.name: Squeaky Plush Bone
products.short: A soft bone with a squeaker inside. Built for cuddles and fetch.
desc: Double-stitched seams and a squeaker that keeps squeaking. Best for gentle players.

products.name: Training Treats Jar
products.short: Small bone-shaped bites, easy to carry on walks.
desc: Bite-sized so you can reward often without overfeeding. Resealable jar keeps them crunchy.
details: Up to 10 pieces a day for a 10 kg dog

products.name: Non-slip Steel Bowl
products.short: Stainless steel with a rubber base that doesn't slide around.
desc: Easy to clean, dishwasher safe, and the removable rubber ring stops the bowl travelling across the kitchen.

products.name: Everyday Harness
products.size_note: Measure the widest part of the chest. See the size guide on the home page.
products.short: A padded no-pull harness that's easy to put on.
desc: Front and back leash rings, soft padding and two buckles — no wrestling over the head.

products.name: Rain-or-shine Leash
products.short: A waterproof coated leash that wipes clean after muddy walks.
desc: Coated webbing doesn't soak up water or smells. Padded handle and a strong swivel clip.

products.name: Name Tag Collar
products.short: A soft collar with a matching ID tag.
desc: Adjustable collar with a quick-release buckle. Add your pet's name and your number to the tag at checkout (demo).

products.name: Feather Wand Toy
products.short: The toy your cat will actually play with.
desc: A flexible wand with a feather-and-bell lure. Comes with one refill.

products.name: Cosy Cat Condo
products.short: A plush hideaway with a scratching post and lookout platform.
desc: A cave to nap in, a platform to watch the world from and sisal posts for scratching. Easy to assemble.
